title: ClearerToday
description: AI speech coach for enunciation practice and adaptive pronunciation feedback.
highlights: Built an AI speech coach for enunciation based on analysis of phoneme-level mouth-shape gaps with MediaPipe Face Mesh and ElevenLabs transcription

Developed an adaptive feedback loop that stores persistent user gap profiles in Convex to rerank future guidance, retrieving live pronunciation references with Exa and generating next-drill instructions scored primarily by OpenAI frontier model.

title: CorrectiveRehabApp
description: End-to-end biomechanical analysis pipeline for gym exercises.
highlights: Detects 8 lift-specific form issues (knee valgus, hip shift, butt wink, forward lean, etc.) with 0–100 symmetry scores and severity grading per rep across 6 exercises

Mobile skeleton visualizer renders react-native-svg overlays (24 joint connections, teal/orange/red severity coloring) with a side-by-side session diff view classifying issues as improved/regressed/resolved/new

title: X Bookmark Injector
description: A Chromium extension that resurfaces a random saved X bookmark at the top of your For You feed.
highlights: Manifest V3 extension that reuses X's own logged-in GraphQL session to sync, de-duplicate, and rank bookmarks, then injects one as a native-looking post — zero backend, zero telemetry, all state local to the browser profile
Durable delete/undo saga survives service-worker restarts with a fail-closed response schema; 290 passing unit, integration, and race tests

title: TradingSignalandHelper
description: A local, paper-first US-stock signal desk with a human-in-the-loop trade helper.
highlights: Turns price candles into BUY/SELL/HOLD calls via an EMA-crossover strategy, then routes each through a review-ticket dashboard showing take-profit, stop-loss, and live broker state before any order is confirmed

Production-minded order lifecycle — SQLite persistence, restart recovery, cross-process duplicate protection, replay-resistant webhooks, and a moomoo/OpenD paper-trading adapter; 152 tests, mock-first by default

title: AppleNotestoX
description: Local-first macOS pipeline that turns Apple Notes into a durable, reviewable knowledge wiki.
highlights: Exports selected Apple Notes to a local Markdown wiki or Notion with in-order inline media and source-stamped origins, plus on-device (Apple Speech) video transcription with keyframes
Pairs the synthesized wiki with a dependency-free study app — SM-2 flashcards, a force-directed concept map, and narrated recaps

title: Concept Visualizer
description: Visual learn technical concepts through AI-powered step-through animated node graph.
highlights: Covers only computer science domains in networking, algorithms, databases, and system design
AI explanations (Groq llama-3.3-70b) rendered as interactive React Flow graphs with Dagre auto-layout
